title: Login page hangs after SSO redirect
body: Users report the login spinner never stops when SSO redirects back. Started after the session cookie change in #89.

title: Login timeout after 30s on slow networks
body: Mobile users on 3G hit a hard 30s timeout before the auth token refresh completes. Need to align with the runbook guidance.

title: Add dark mode to settings
body: Request from design: respect prefers-color-scheme in the settings panel.

title: Password reset email missing login link
body: Reset emails pointed to an old domain. Fixed by updating the mail template.

title: Document login timeout troubleshooting
body: Ops wants the runbook linked from the issue tracker FAQ so agents and humans use the same steps.

title: Export CSV for billing reports
body: Finance needs a CSV export of monthly invoices.

title: Login rate limit too aggressive for QA
body: Shared QA accounts get locked after 5 attempts. Consider a bypass for the staging IP range.

title: Flaky e2e test: login form submit
body: Race on hydration. Stabilized with waitForSelector.
